figure-hero.purpose: The equity figure — largest type on the board; cents de-emphasized.

status-label.purpose: The flap-set state word (LIVE / STALE / KILL SWITCH) in the status band.

ticker.purpose: Tape items and the PAPER badge; condensed caps always tracked.

board-cap.purpose: Section headers and captions; the row is the header.

digits.purpose: Every numeral, timestamp and note — tabular-nums mandatory.

shadows.name: lamp-halo
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system: the status lamp glowing in its own state color (7px variant on event lamps).

motion.name: tape-roll
motion.purpose: Key-figure tape; pauses on hover; off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: row-clack
motion.purpose: Event rows entering the tape log.

motion.name: flap-cascade
motion.value: 45ms glyph steps, bounded 4–7 steps per cell, 60ms per-character stagger, settle-on-target
motion.purpose: Signature interaction: status word, UTC clock, last-cycle time.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.value: 1024px — board widens 520px → 780px, position columns widen, wt-bar goes fluid

components.name: Paper Badge
components.description: Stamped header cell: lamp dot + PAPER TRADING caps. Always visible — the surface never represents live trading.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #e8e4d8; background: #0f1113; border-right: 1px solid #23282d; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e8e4d8; }

components.name: Status Lamp
components.description: 10px state dot with self-colored halo; green ok, amber attention (blinks never), red kill (blinks 1.4s).
components.css: .ds-lamp { --lamp-color: #35c56e; display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lamp-color); box-shadow: 0 0 10px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--lamp-color) 45%, transparent); } .ds-lamp--warn { --lamp-color: #e5a50a; } .ds-lamp--kill { --lamp-color: #e5484d; animation: ds-blink 1.4s steps(2, start) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-lamp--kill { animation: none; } }

components.name: Flap Cell
components.description: Split-flap digit tile with hinge line; cells roll glyphs and settle on target when state changes.
components.html: 12:34
components.css: .ds-flap { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-flap-cell { position: relative; display: inline-block; min-width: 0.72em; padding: 2px 4px; background: #191d21; border: 1px solid #23282d; border-radius: 3px; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: #e8e4d8; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-flap-cell::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 1px; background: rgba(15, 17, 19, 0.85); }

components.name: Event Row
components.description: Ruled tape-log row: 7px state lamp, tabular HH:MM, caps event name over ellipsized detail.
components.html: 10:47CYCLE FINISHok exit=0 submitted 3 orders
components.css: .ds-event { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px 62px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; padding: 9px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #23282d; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-event-lamp { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #35c56e; align-self: center; } .ds-event-time { font-size: 11px; color: #8a867c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-event-name { display: block; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #e8e4d8; } .ds-event-detail { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 11.5px; color: #a5a196; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview: The dashboard is one dark lacquered surface in the manner of an exchange quote board: every fact lives in a ruled row, every row obeys fixed columns, and nothing floats. The 1px hairline grid is the entire composition. The bot's state reads like a listing on the board, and when the bot goes quiet, the board says so in lamp grammar instead of going blank. Density is high but calm: warm ivory ink on near-black steel, tabular monospaced numerals, condensed caps tickers, and exactly three chromatic voices — the lamps.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous ruled surface; sections are bands separated by 1px hairlines, not stacked cards.
Lamp grammar: green ok/up, amber attention (reserved by law), red kill (blinking).
Every numeral in IBM Plex Mono tabular-nums; every label in tracked Barlow Condensed caps.
The flap cascade is the signature interaction; motion is mechanical and stepped.
Read-only by contract — the board states, the operator acts in the repo.

rules.name: The Amber Register Rule
rules.body: Amber is the attention register — warnings, the DEMO band, focus, selection — and nothing else. If amber is on screen, something needs looking at.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Hairline Rule
rules.body: All structure is 1px rules in exactly two weights (#23282d / #2f363c). Never thicker, never a different gray.

rules.name: The Ink Ladder Rule
rules.body: Three ivory steps: full paint, dimmed, etched (#8a867c floor for small text — legibility, not preference).

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed speaks labels; IBM Plex Mono speaks everything numeric or annotative. Never crossed.

rules.name: Columns Never Move
rules.body: Table columns are fixed; wider viewports widen the grid, never reflow, stack, or hide columns.

rules.name: The Only Glow Is a Live Lamp
rules.body: box-shadow exists once: the lamp's own halo. Surfaces never cast shadows.

dos: Do use the lamp grammar for every state; a colored pixel is always a state.
Do set every numeral in tabular mono, right-aligned in tables.
Do render system truth (stale, kill, demo) even when ugly.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for every animation.
donts: Don't use cards, glass, gradients-as-chrome, or surface shadows.
Don't use amber as decoration or brand accent.
Don't add icon fonts, unicode glyphs, or emoji — authored inline SVG only.
Don't introduce write affordances — the board is read-only.
